arguments.body: Hello, sorry, our automated questions about a fridge were wrong. We understand the problem is your front door (and back door), which only shuts if slammed, and that there is a risk the glass could break. We have logged it as an urgent door repair. Meanwhile, please avoid slamming it, keep people and pets away from the glass, and make sure the door is properly locked when you go out or at night. If glass cracks, keep clear and tell us straight away. Could you tell us: 1) is the glass cracked or loose now? 2) does the door not latch, or is it sticking or dropping? 3) what are the best times for access, and any alarm or entry codes? 4) any pets? We are asking the landlord to approve the repair and will update you by 7 June. Our target for urgent work is within 72 hours once approved.

arguments.body: Hello, sorry, our automated questions about a fridge were wrong. We understand the problem is your front door (and back door), which only shuts if slammed, and that there is a risk the glass could break. We have logged it as an urgent door repair. Meanwhile, please avoid slamming it, keep people and pets away from the glass, and make sure the door is properly locked when you go out or at night. If glass cracks, keep clear and tell us straight away. Could you tell us: 1) is the glass cracked or loose now? 2) does the door not latch, or is it sticking or dropping? 3) what are the best times for access, and any alarm or entry codes? 4) any pets? We are asking the landlord to approve the repair and will update you by 7 June. Our target for urgent work is within 72 hours once approved.
